hook_text: Can K-Stick open a snack silently?
background: Simple cozy kitchen with a counter, cabinet, and reusable warm pastel backdrop
main_expression: Confident grin changing into wide-eyed panic, then embarrassed relief
main_pose: Tiptoeing with one arm stretched toward a snack bag and the other hand raised for silence
scene_1: K-Stick tiptoes into the kitchen and points proudly at a snack bag. Text appears: "Operation: Silent Snack."
scene_2: He slowly opens the bag, but it makes an enormous crinkle sound. K-Stick freezes with huge eyes while tiny sound-wave lines fill the screen.
scene_3: K-Stick nervously looks around, then holds the bag behind his back and pretends to whistle innocently.
twist_ending: The snack bag suddenly crinkles by itself from behind him. K-Stick jumps, then discovers his red cap is stuffed with snacks and has been making the noise. He shrugs and eats one proudly.
facebook_caption: He had one job: open the snack quietly. The snack bag had other plans! 😂
youtube_description: K-Stick attempts the ultimate silent snack mission, but one noisy bag and a suspicious red cap ruin everything. A quick, family-friendly stickman comedy reel.
image_prompt: Original simple 2D stickman animation frame featuring K-Stick, a black stickman with a round white face, huge expressive eyes, and a signature red cap, inside a cozy minimalist kitchen. He is tiptoeing beside a counter while reaching for a colorful crinkly snack bag. Clean bold outlines, flat colors, playful cartoon style, expressive pose, no copyrighted characters, no text, vertical 9:16 composition.
motion_prompt: 15-second fast-paced 2D stickman animation. Start with K-Stick tiptoeing confidently toward the snack bag and pointing at it. Cut quickly to his slow careful opening attempt as the bag produces exaggerated crinkle lines and a loud visual shake. Hold on his wide-eyed frozen panic. He hides the bag behind his back and fake-whistles while glancing side to side. End with the bag crinkling behind him, making him jump; reveal snacks stuffed inside his red cap, then show him shrugging and happily eating one. Use simple reusable kitchen background, limited character poses, quick squash-and-stretch reactions, and family-friendly comedic timing.
